pr_title: sensor: adxl3xx: Move run-time ODR changes from cfg to data
pr_body:
`cfg` struct is constant and attempting to modify it triggers a fault. Instead, moved to `data`.

Fixes #83853
pr_comments: I'll change this PR based on feedback obtained in the issue: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/83853#issuecomment-2587181708
Fixed a typo on the `adxl372_data` struct. Should pass now

issue_context.title: ADXL sensor drivers attempt to modify config struct at run-time
issue_context.body:
<!--
**Notes**
Github Discussions (https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/discussions)
are available to first verify that the issue is a genuine Zephyr bug and not a
consequence of Zephyr services misuse.

This issue list is only for bugs in the main Zephyr code base
(https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/). If the bug is for a project
fork (such as NCS) specific feature, please open an issue in the fork project
instead.
-->

**Describe the bug**
Drivers for ADXL345 and ADXL372 attempt to modify the config struct when setting ODR attribute:
- ADXL345: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/99a63a776980f855493ceb99036a5974a2b68fb5/drivers/sensor/adi/adxl345/adxl345.c#L260
- ADXL372: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/99a63a776980f855493ceb99036a5974a2b68fb5/drivers/sensor/adi/adxl372/adxl372.c#L578

Since config struct is constant, modifying it triggers a fault.

This is present since 4.0.0:
- ADXL345: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/80004
- ADXL372: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/78941

**To Reproduce**

Build `samples/drivers/sensor/accel_polling` with either of these sensors, and it will crash, since this sample sets the ODR.

**Expected behavior**
Config struct is not modified at run-time.
comments: Should ODR be in the data struct instead of config?

> Should ODR be in the data struct instead of config?

I hadn't seen any references in the file (`get_attr()` is not implemented), henced I had the PR removing it. I did take another look and I see it's referenced in `process_fifo_samples_cb` in Streaming mode. I'll add it back up in `data`. Thanks!
triaging as low as you're already working on a fix :)

review_comments: Does this need an explicit cast to `adxl372_dev_data`?
Not needed, although it may be beneficial for clarity. The existing predominant pattern in both drivers is not casting, though.
